blogs.title: Orthogonal Finetuning 101: A Geometry‑Driven Way to Adapt Giant AI Models
blogs.description: An introductory guide that explains why preserving pairwise neuron angles matters, how orthogonal finetuning (OFT) works, and why it offers stability advantages over popular methods like LoRA.

blogs.title: When Flexibility Meets Cost: The Parameter Bloat Problem in OFT
blogs.description: A deep dive into the original OFT’s reliance on full‑dimensional orthogonal matrices, why this leads to millions of trainable weights, and how the block‑diagonal shortcut tries to save space at the price of expressiveness.

blogs.title: Butterfly Factorization Unleashed – From FFT to Parameter‑Efficient AI
blogs.description: Learn how the butterfly graph used in fast Fourier transforms inspires a sparse‑yet‑dense connectivity pattern that reduces the number of learnable parameters from O(d²) to O(d log d).

blogs.title: BOFT in Action: How Orthogonal Butterfly Slashes Parameters While Keeping Performance
blogs.description: An accessible walkthrough of the BOFT method—including its product of sparse orthogonal matrices, identity initialization, and multiplicative dropout—and why it retains the benefits of OFT with far fewer trainable weights.

blogs.title: Beyond LoRA – Benchmarking BOFT on Vision Transformers, Large Language Models, and Diffusion Generators
blogs.description: A results‑focused post that compares BOFT against state‑of‑the‑art PEFT techniques across vision, language, and text‑to‑image tasks, highlighting gains in accuracy, stability, and parameter efficiency.

blogs.title: The Information Transmission View – Visualizing Matrix Factorizations as Network Graphs
blogs.description: Explains how representing orthogonal matrix factorization as information flow on a grid‑structured graph makes sparsity patterns intuitive and opens the door for future network‑topology inspired designs.
